reviews.title: I’m honestly fed up with Moovit.
reviews.text:
I’m a soldier who relies heavily on public transportation, including buses and trains, so I use this app constantly. At this point, using Moovit has become an exercise in patience.

The amount of ads is ridiculous. I understand that ads help support a free app, but when they constantly interrupt the experience and make it harder to quickly check a bus or train, it becomes incredibly frustrating — especially when you’re already in a hurry trying to get somewhere.

And the map accuracy is another huge problem. The positions of buses and trains are frequently inaccurate or completely wrong. When you’re relying on an app to tell you where your bus or train is, seeing it supposedly arrive somewhere when it’s actually nowhere near that location is extremely frustrating. When you’re trying to catch a connection, inaccurate information can mean missing your bus or train entirely.

As a soldier who uses public transportation constantly, this isn’t just a minor inconvenience. I depend on this app to get to and from places on time. When the information is wrong and the app is filled with interruptions, it makes an already stressful commute even more frustrating.

Moovit needs to seriously improve the accuracy of its live locations and schedules and tone down the aggressive advertising. I don’t mind using a free app with reasonable ads, but when the ads interfere with basic functionality while the actual transportation information can be inaccurate, it becomes incredibly frustrating.

reviews.title: Slow, buggy, drains battery
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Moovit for a few years, when I first started I was really impressed with how easy to navigate the UI was, I also really liked the live location feature and the app worked really well. Then they started pushing more adds. The app now takes so long to load that by the time I can choose a route I’ve already missed my bus, but the 3 unskippable ads I had to see first loaded just fine 
Opening the app takes to long, choosing a route, loading again, god forbid I choose the wrong option and have to wait a minute and watch an ad to try to choose something else
My breaking point was when the app randomly decided to erase all of my favorited locations for the second time
Not to mention that a 30 minute ride with the app open in the bg drains half my phone battery.
I am well aware of the paid subscription ad-less model, the app won’t stop trying to make me pay for it. But it is very frustrating to be met with a paywall to use something that worked better 5 years ago for free 

TL;DR: if you mostly rely on trains and the light rail to get around, you are better off using Google Maps
I no longer believe that the live location feature makes up for the headache that using Moovit gives me

reviews.title: This app lies and will get you lost (Italy)
reviews.text:
Moovit makes the bold assumption of being operable in Italy, an assumption I made the grave mistake of believing. 

I was heading to a street called “Via Europa 3” an Address of which I copy-pasted that I needed to get to by bus. What followed was an onslaught of misinformation on the location of the bus stops, a lack of clarity in the type of bus I needed, and most damningly: THE TIMES THEY ARRIVED. Bus stops were 2 blocks away, bus times were up to 20 MINUTES off, which built up to me having to walk home in the rain on the side of the highway into the bounds of the city which uses a bikeshare app so I can get home. I pity any poor soul who downloads this app instead of the myriad of other options the internet has, and consider this app still being available for download as an attack on your time, on your patience, and your freedom.

I never got to Via Europa 3, because Moovit took me to the wrong street of the same name. If someone tells you to download this app, that person hates you and wants you to get lost. Do NOT make the mistake of downloading this.

reviews.text:
The Live Ride function no longer works. It used to be great. Moovit+ would wake me up two stops before my bus stop to alert me to start getting ready to get off the bus. But since end of September or beginning of October 2025, every time I try to use Live Ride, it says "Try again - Live Ride could not start because this line isn't active right now." Not active? I'm literally on the that bus line right now! The bus picked me up, it's moving, and it's dropping me off. How is it not active???

I submitted a support ticket on or around October 2, 2025, and they gave me an excuse that they get their information from a third party and maybe there's a problem with that information. That's not my problem. It's now been over two and a half months, and instead of getting better, the issue has spread to other bus lines that I use as well. Nowhere near an acceptable amount of time to resolve a problem that so significantly impacts the use of a paid app.
